title: feat: Add RFC 8707 resource parameter support for JWT access tokens
summary:
# ✨ Feature / Enhancement PR

## 🔗 Epic / Issue
Closes #2149 

---

## 🚀 Summary (1-2 sentences)
Adds RFC 8707 Resource Indicators support to enable OAuth providers to return JWT tokens instead of opaque tokens. This fixes "Invalid Compact JWS" errors when MCP servers expect JWT tokens but receive opaque tokens from OAuth providers.

---

## 🧪 Checks

- [ x] `make lint` passes
- [ x] `make test` passes
- [ x] CHANGELOG updated (if user-facing)

---

## 📓 Notes (optional)
This implements RFC 8707 Resource Indicators by:
- Setting the `resource` parameter to `gateway.url` in the OAuth authorization flow
- Passing `resource` through to the token exchange request in the callback endpoint
- Including `resource` in both the authorization URL and token request

The resource parameter signals to OAuth providers that support both token types (like BetterAuth) that a JWT token should be returned for the specified resource (the MCP server URL), rather than defaulting to an opaque token.
